title: My Home and My Cat
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big tree in the garden. The tree is very old.

My cat is black and white. Her name is Milly. She is small, but she is very fast. She likes to sleep on my bed.

questions.text: What does the cat like to do?
What can we guess about the tree?
How does the writer probably feel about the cat?

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land next to a house where plants and trees grow
openings in a wall that let in light and air
having lived or existed for many years

paragraph_translations: Mój dom jest mały i niebieski. Ma dwa okna i czerwone drzwi. W ogrodzie jest duże drzewo. Drzewo jest bardzo stare.
Moja kotka jest czarno-biała. Ma na imię Milly. Ona jest mała, ale bardzo szybka. Lubi spać na moim łóżku.
